# Carpe Vita Sailboat Charters (concept by Kerblabs, not live)

> Private catamaran charters out of West Palm Beach, FL aboard Carpe Vita, a 42-ft Fountaine Pajot Venezia, captained by Cal and Marty Landau. Facts from florida-sailboatcharters.com.

## Details
- Departure: dock at the end of Evernia Street on Flagler Drive, West Palm Beach (Peanut Island charters: Sailfish Marina)
- Capacity: up to 6 guests; overnight charters limited to 2 guests
- Phone: (561) 312-0010
- Email: clandau3@gmail.com

## Trips and listed rates
- Day Cruise: $350 per hour
- Intracoastal Cruise: $350 to $700 (1 to 2 hours)
- Sunday Brunch: $1,075 to $1,500 (2.5 hours)
- Sunset Dinner: $1,250 to $1,700 (3 hours)
- Peanut Island Summer: $300 per hour
- Florida Keys: $5,000 (3 days, 2 nights)

## Actions
- Book or enquire: call (561) 312-0010 or email clandau3@gmail.com. Confirm final pricing with the captains.

## Machine-readable
- /services.json lists trips, rates, capacity and booking actions
